lines.en: label utaspring1:
scene black
{i}Meanwhile...deep within the beating heart of Kumon-mi...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……在 Kumon-mi 跳动的心脏深处……{/i}

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn1
: I sincerely apologize for being away for so long!
lines.zh: : 我真诚地为离开这么久而道歉！

lines.en: : And also for maybe saying a few things about how I would take your organs!
lines.zh: : 也为我之前可能说过几句要掏你们器官的话道歉！

lines.en: : Please let me work here again! I need money!
lines.zh: : 请让我再在这儿工作吧！我需要钱！

lines.en: : Ami, calm down! You don’t need to bow! It’s okay! We didn’t hire anyone in your place!
lines.zh: : Ami，冷静点！你不用鞠躬！没关系的！我们没有招人顶替你！

lines.en: : No, but we probably {i}should{/i} have. She’s been gone for months and the customers have barely even noticed.
lines.zh: : 不，但我们本{i}该{/i}招一个。她都走了好几个月了，客人们几乎根本没发现。

lines.en: : That’s only because Uta is super good at her job and steals all of the regular customers! But you’re right! I don’t deserve to be here anymore!
lines.zh: : 那只是因为 Uta 太能干了，把常客全抢走了！但你说得对！我已经不配待在这儿了！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn2
: Chika, come on. Ami’s technically your senpai, you know. And she’s been going through a really tough time lately. We need to be {i}understanding{/i} in her time of need.
lines.zh: : Chika，行了。Ami 严格来说算是你的前辈，你知道的。而且她最近经历了一段很艰难的日子。在她需要的时候，我们得{i}体谅{/i}一点。

lines.en: : For example, when my grandpa was dying of brain cancer-
lines.zh: : 比如，我爷爷脑癌快死的时候——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. My mom died too and you don’t see me using that as an anecdote to explain away all of the times I’ve had to stick up for Yumi. Save the dead grandpa card for when it’s needed or it’ll lose its impact.
lines.zh: :  blah blah blah。我妈也死了，也没见我拿这当段子，来解释我每次都得站出来护着 Yumi 的事。死爷爷这张牌留到需要的时候再打，不然就不灵了。

lines.en: : I don’t mind if Ami comes back. She can handle some of the cooking again since I had to pick up the slack for her.
lines.zh: : 我不介意 Ami 回来。她可以重新接手一部分后厨的活，之前她的份都是我顶下来的。

lines.en: : Of course! I’ll do anything!
lines.zh: : 当然！我什么都愿意做！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn3
: Really? Then surrender Sensei to me. Platonically, of course. I just don’t feel comfortable with him being in the hands of a psychopath.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那就把 Sensei 交给我吧。当然是柏拉图式的。我只是不放心把他留在一个疯子手里。

lines.en: : You too? Really?
lines.zh: : 你也来？真的假的？

lines.en: : I will do {i}almost{/i} anything! Sensei has to stay with me or we’ll both burst into flames! It’s part of the Arakawa family curse!
lines.zh: : 我{i}几乎{/i}什么都愿意做！Sensei 必须跟我在一起，不然我们俩都会自燃！这是 Arakawa 家的诅咒的一部分！

lines.en: : I would like to exercise my seniority here to remind Chika that she’s still technically the newest employee. Even if she {i}has{/i} managed to build up a bit of a following in Ami’s absence.
lines.zh: : 我想在这儿行使一下我的资历，提醒 Chika 一句：严格来说她依然是资历最浅的员工。即便她{i}确实{/i}在 Ami 不在的这段时间里攒下了一点人气。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn4
: Wait, really? How? I’ve been here way longer and no one’s ever asked for me who I’m not already friends or relatives with.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？怎么做到的？我在这儿待得久多了，除了本来就认识我的朋友和亲戚，从来没人指名找过我。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’m just better than you. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 能说什么呢？我就是比你强。就这么简单。

lines.en: : It’s not as simple as that. Chika caters to two demographics at once between her being half-Filipino and also a gyaru.
lines.zh: : 可没那么简单。Chika 同时吃定了两拨客人——她有一半菲律宾血统，而且还是个辣妹。

lines.en: : {i}Former{/i} gyaru mostly. I’m a cool rocker chick now.
lines.zh: : 基本是{i}前{/i}辣妹。我现在是个酷酷的摇滚妹了。

lines.en: : And also, since you sucked at being tsundere, you were checking the same boxes that {i}I{/i} check but at a much lower rate. You’ll never steal cute-type customers away from Uta-chan. That’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 还有，因为你演傲娇演得很烂，你勾选的是和{i}我{/i}一样的选项，只是命中率低得多。你永远别想从 Uta 酱手里抢走喜欢可爱型的客人。那是不可能的。

lines.en: : Well...what am I supposed to do now? Because I can’t put myself in twintails anymore and Osako already caters to the customers looking for a boyish maid.
lines.zh: : 那……我现在该怎么办？因为我已经不能梳双马尾了，而 Osako 已经把想找男孩子气女仆的客人包圆了。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn5
: Hey!
: We just need to reinvent you!
lines.zh: : 我们只需要把你重新包装一下！

lines.en: : Or you could find another job. Les Vetements might be hiring a replacement for me soon if they’re still there after the mall is finished being renovated.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以另找份工作。等商场装修完，如果 Les Vetements 还在的话，可能很快就要招人替我了。

lines.en: : Ignore Chika. She’s just upset that she won’t be able to cover your shifts anymore and is going to slip back into poverty.
lines.zh: : 别理 Chika。她只是因为以后没法再替你顶班、要重新滑回贫困线而闹脾气罢了。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn6
: Hey!
: It doesn’t matter who you are or what you want to be, Ami. What matters is that you’re back. We can figure out your new archetype over your next few shifts.
lines.zh: : 你是谁、你想成为什么样的人都不重要，Ami。重要的是你回来了。你的新定位我们可以在接下来几班慢慢想。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn7
: But for now — we’ve got a show to run, ladies! Fix your clothes! Fix your makeup! Then get on out there and show our guests a good time!
lines.zh: : 不过现在——我们还有一场秀要演呢，各位！整理衣服！补好妆！然后出去给客人们好好乐呵乐呵！

lines.en: : Just not {i}that{/i} kind of good time because this isn’t that kind of place!
lines.zh: : 只是别给{i}那种{/i}乐呵，因为这儿不是那种地方！

lines.en: : Fine. But Ami’s SOL if she didn’t bring her uniform with her since we don’t have any extras.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过要是 Ami 没把制服带来，那她就只能自求多福了，因为我们没有多余的。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn8
: She’s not gonna work today anyway. I’ll have her start again next weekend or something.
lines.zh: : 反正她今天也不上工。我让她下周末或者什么时候再开始。

lines.en: : For now, just let me go over some of the stuff that’s changed with her while she’s been gone and I’ll get back with you and Osako-chan in a sec. Think you can hold down the fort?
lines.zh: : 现在先让我跟她过一遍她不在的这段时间里发生的变化，我一会儿就回去找你和 Osako 酱。你们守得住店吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure we can figure it out.
lines.zh: : 我们应该应付得来。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, Osako-chan. Let’s leave Uta alone with the gremlin and hope that she isn’t eaten alive.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Osako 酱。让 Uta 单独跟这个小怪物待着，祈祷她别被生吞了。

lines.en: : There isn’t going to be any sort of drama in here from now on, is there? Because I’ve kind of enjoyed how peaceful things have been lately.
lines.zh: : 从今往后这儿不会再闹什么幺蛾子了吧？因为我最近还挺享受这种太平日子的。

lines.en: : Beats me. Ami’s the one you want to ask.
lines.zh: : 问我干嘛。你要问的是 Ami。

lines.en: : That’s Ami-{i}chan{/i} to you!
lines.zh: : 是 Ami-{i}酱{/i}！

lines.en: : Not while she’s not in unifoooooorm!~
lines.zh: : 没穿制~~~~服就不算！~

lines.en: : Out! Be gone! Vanish!
lines.zh: : 出去！消失！遁形！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn9
: Thanks a lot for sticking up for me, Uta...
lines.zh: : 太谢谢你替我说话了，Uta……

lines.en: : You really didn’t have to do that after I was so mean to you when you...well...broke into my house...
lines.zh: : 在你……那个……闯进我家之后我还对你那么刻薄，你真的不用这样。

lines.en: : Relax! And let’s not talk about anything either one of us may have done that may or may not have been illegal!
lines.zh: : 放松！还有，我们谁干过什么可能违法也可能不违法的事，就都别提了！

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re back, Ami. I like your hair.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你回来了，Ami。我喜欢你的头发。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn10
: Do you really? Sana’s mom did it when we were camping the other day. You don’t think it’s a little too masculine?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？前几天我们去露营的时候 Sana 的妈妈给我弄的。你不觉得有点太男孩子气了吗？

lines.en: : Maybe a little bit, but I think you can pull it off. And I’m not just saying that because no one would be able to tell that you’re a girl from fifteen to twenty feet away.
lines.zh: : 也许有那么一点，但我觉得你撑得起来。而且我这么说，可不光是因为隔十五到二十英尺根本没人能看出你是女生。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn11
: Please don’t remind me. I’m dealing with enough as-is right now. The last thing I need is even more breast envy.
lines.zh: : 求你别提醒我。我现在已经够烦的了。我最不需要的就是再多一份对胸的羡慕。

lines.en: : Don’t feel bad! Mine were small once too!
lines.zh: : 别难过！我的以前也很小！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn12
: But I guess you already know that since you saw my pictures in Sensei’s phone!
lines.zh: : 不过我猜你早就知道了，毕竟你看到过 Sensei 手机里我的照片！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn13
: Ahh, crap.
lines.zh: : 啊，糟糕。

lines.en: : Mhm. We’re gonna talk about this now.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们现在得谈谈这件事。

lines.en: : I know...I completely forgot about those until you said something.
lines.zh: : 我知道……在你提起之前，我完全把那些事给忘了。

lines.en: : That’s perfectly fine! Because I’ve been waiting a really long time for you to not be completely miserable so I can tell you all about how that made {i}me{/i} feel!
lines.zh: : 那正好！因为{i}我{/i}等了很久很久，就等你不再那么凄惨，好把这件事让我心里是什么滋味全告诉你！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn14
: Nothing has changed here while I’ve been gone, has it?
lines.zh: : 我走之后这儿一点都没变，是吧？

lines.en: : We have a new parfait. Orientation done. Now, about those pictures!
lines.zh: : 我们上了一款新芭菲。入职培训结束。现在，说说那些照片！

lines.en: : What do you want to know? You’ve always been nice to me, so I have no reason to lie to you.
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么？你一直对我很好，所以我没理由对你撒谎。

lines.en: : How many were there? What was I doing in them? Did he send them to anyone else? Are there copies? Does he still have them? Did you delete them? Did he say anything about them?
lines.zh: : 有多少张？我在里面干什么？他发给别人了吗？有没有备份？他还留着吗？你删掉了吗？他说过什么没有？

lines.en: : Do you have a preference on...which one of those I answer first?
lines.zh: : 你对……我先回答哪一个有偏好吗？

lines.en: : Maybe answer this one instead and we can go from there.
lines.zh: : 也许你先回答这个，然后我们再往下聊。

lines.en: : What kind of girl do you think I am, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是哪种女孩，Ami？

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn15
: What kind of...girl?...
lines.zh: : 哪种……女孩？……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Like, I’m sure you think {i}I{/i} sent that stuff to him, don’t you? Which would mean you think I’m probably a desperate whore or something along those lines, right?
lines.zh: : 比如，{i}我{/i}敢肯定你觉得我是自己把那些东西发给他的，对吧？那也就是说，你觉得我大概是个饥渴的婊子之类的，对吧？

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn16
: I don’t know how he got them...but I can tell you weren’t the one who sent them based on how you’re reacting to this.
lines.zh: : 我不知道他是怎么弄到的……但从你现在的反应来看，我能断定不是你发的。

lines.en: : What kind of girl do you think I am, Ami? Answer the question.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是哪种女孩，Ami？回答这个问题。

lines.en: : You really {i}do{/i} think I’m just a thirsty slut, huh?
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}觉得我只是个发骚的荡妇，是吧？

lines.en: : Because I am.
lines.zh: : 因为我是。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn17
: I took all sorts of pictures like that when I was younger, you know. Sent them to tons of guys...didn’t even get anything in return most of the time, but I was okay with that.
lines.zh: : 我年轻的时候拍过各种各样的那种照片，你知道的。发给过好多男人……大多数时候连点回报都没有，但我就愿意那样。

lines.en: : Doing those things made me feel wanted. They made me feel {i}pretty.{/i}
lines.zh: : 做那些事让我觉得被需要。它们让我觉得自己{i}漂亮{/i}。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn18
: And I was still learning how my body worked, so I did {i}tons{/i} of self-exploring back then, if you catch my drift.
lines.zh: : 而且那时候我还在摸索自己的身体，所以我做了{i}无数次{/i}自我探索，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Uta...
lines.zh: : Uta……

lines.en: : And I mean {i}tons.{/i} Several times a day. It was kind of like an addiction. But I’m sure you know how it is, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说{i}无数次{/i}。一天好几次。有点像上瘾。不过我敢说你懂那种感觉，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m sure you got a little too handsy with yourself once {i}you{/i} realized how to make yourself feel good. Right?...
lines.zh: : 我敢说，{i}你{/i}一旦知道怎么让自己舒服，也对自己动过手吧。对吧？……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn19
: Not much has changed on that end, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这方面到现在也没怎么变。

lines.en: : I still do it all the time. Still spend way too many hours with my mind in the gutter.
lines.zh: : 我还是经常做。还是会把太多时间花在脑子里那些下流念头上。

lines.en: : But you know, Ami?...That’s exactly where I belong.
lines.zh: : 不过你知道吗，Ami？……我恰恰就属于那儿。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn18
: I can’t even make a {i}guess{/i} about how many guys must have jerked off to me when I was growing up. But I’m sure it’s a lot since those pictures have been following me {i}everywhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我甚至没法{i}猜出{/i}，我成长的过程中有多少男人对着我想入非非过。但我敢肯定数量很多，因为那些照片一直{i}到处{/i}跟着我。

lines.en: : That’s why I {i}really{/i} moved, you know? Taking care of my grandpa was just a thing I also happened to do when I got here.
lines.zh: 所以我{i}真的{/i}搬了家，你知道的？我来到这儿的时候，顺便也照顾了爷爷。

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t be here at all if I wasn’t a needy, naughty girl who sought attention from the wrong people.
lines.zh: : 可如果我不是个向错误的人索求关注的、黏人又下流的女孩，我根本就不会出现在这儿。

lines.en: : One of them wound up stalking me. I guess the Internet wasn’t enough and he wanted a taste of the real thing.
lines.zh: : 其中一个后来开始跟踪我。我猜网络已经不够了，他想尝尝真货。

lines.en: : But that didn’t last long since my brother caught wind of it and attacked him before he could lay his hands on me.
lines.zh: : 不过那没持续多久，因为我哥听到了风声，在他能碰我之前就动手揍了他。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn20
: You think I would have done it, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我当时会那么做吗，Ami？

lines.en: : You think I would have let some old guy fuck me back then?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我当时会让某个老男人操我吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know, Uta...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Uta……

lines.en: : Me either.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。

lines.en: : And that’s what’s so fucking scary about it.
lines.zh: : 而这正是它他妈吓人的地方。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn21
: Even now...even though it terrifies me...makes me nauseous...and quite literally makes my life borderline unlivable sometimes, I {i}still don’t know.{/i}
lines.zh: : 即便是现在……即便它让我恐惧……让我恶心……甚至有时候真的让我的生活几近无法过下去，我{i}还是不知道{/i}。

lines.en: : Part of me {i}still{/i} gets excited thinking about that stuff. But then part of me wants to throw up and it all cancels out.
lines.zh: : 有一部分我{i}依然{/i}会因为想到那些事而兴奋。但另一部分的我又想吐，然后它们就互相抵消了。

lines.en: : You don’t think Sensei is...sending your pictures around, do you?...
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得 Sensei 在……到处发你的照片吧？……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn22
: Probably not. But if there’s anything I know about older guys — and again, I know {i}a lot {/i}— it’s definitely safe to say he’s jerking off to them. And I know how that makes {i}me{/i} feel...
lines.zh: : 大概不会。但要说我了解年长男人的哪一点——再说一遍，我了解得{i}可多了{/i}——那肯定可以断言，他在对着它们打飞机。而我知道那让{i}我自己{/i}是什么感觉……

lines.en: : But how does it make {i}you{/i} feel? How has it changed the way you look at him? And how are you going to look at {i}me{/i} from now on knowing that I'm into it?
lines.zh: : 可{i}你{/i}是什么感觉？这改变了你看他的方式吗？还有，从今往后你要怎么看{i}我{/i}——明知我还乐在其中？

lines.en: : Can we still be friends? Am I in danger? What happens if those pictures aren’t enough for Sensei anymore? What if {i}he{/i} comes after me next? Then what, Ami?
lines.zh: : 我们还能做朋友吗？我有危险吗？要是那些照片对 Sensei 来说已经不够了会怎样？要是{i}他{/i}下一个找上我呢？那怎么办，Ami？

lines.en: : Don’t hold back. I want to hear what’s on your mind. It’ll distract me from what’s going on in mine.
lines.zh: : 别憋着。我想听听你在想什么。这样我就不用想自己在想什么了。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn23
: Nothing will ever change the way I look at Sensei. But {i}that...{/i}
lines.zh: : 什么都不可能改变我看 Sensei 的方式。但{i}那件事……{/i}

lines.en: : That’s a part of him I’ve kind of...known about for a really long time.
lines.zh: : 那是他的一部分，我其实……很早以前就知道了。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn24

: I was the same when I was younger, Uta. Desperate to be {i}wanted.{/i} To feel {i}love.{/i} But the main difference between us is that my feelings were aimed at one person and yours were just...everywhere.
lines.zh: : 我小时候也是这样，Uta。拼命想{i}被人需要{/i}。想感受{i}爱{/i}。但我们之间最大的区别是，我的感情指向一个人，而你的只是……到处都是。

lines.en: : So while you were sending pictures of yourself to people all over the Internet, I was touching myself in my uncle’s bed...hoping he’d wake up and have his way with me.
lines.zh: : 所以当你把自拍发给网上各种人的时候，我正躺在我叔叔的床上自慰……盼着他能醒过来，对我为所欲为。

lines.en: : Which one of us do you think is worse now?
lines.zh: : 现在你觉得我们俩哪个更糟？

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn25
: You were really cute back then. I don’t blame Sensei one bit for touching himself to your pictures. I’m just a little jealous, that’s all...
lines.zh: : 你那时候真的很可爱。我一点都不怪 Sensei 对着你的照片自慰。我只是有那么一点嫉妒，就这样……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn26
: Jealous?...
: Yeah...
: I’ve seen the way he looks at you...the way you look at him...and that makes me want to tie him up and do all of the things that you’re too afraid to.
lines.zh: : 我见过他看你的样子……也见过你看他的样子……那让我想把他绑起来，把所有你不敢对他做的事都做了。

lines.en: : This isn’t really...how I thought things would go when I told you about-
lines.zh: : 这真的……不是我告诉你那些事时预想的发展方向——

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn27
: It’s hard to predict how things will go...What...wrong decision or...{i}mistake{/i} we’ll make next...
lines.zh: : 事情会怎么发展是很难预料的……我们下一步会……犯下什么错误的决定或{i}错误{/i}……

lines.en: : Even when you think you know how things are going to play out...one wrong turn and everything gets thrown into chaos.
lines.zh: : 即便你以为自己知道事情会怎么展开……只要走错一步，一切就会被抛进混乱。

lines.en: : I don’t blame you for what you did back then...or how it impacted who you are today...
lines.zh: : 我不怪你当年的所作所为……也不怪它如何塑造了今天的你……

lines.en: : Because the truth is, Uta...
lines.zh: : 因为说实话，Uta……

lines.en: : I think you’re perfect.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很完美。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} the kind of girl I think you are...
lines.zh: : {i}那就是{/i}我认为你是的那种女孩……

lines.en: : You...
: N...No...I just told you all of those things about me. That’s...That isn’t perfect...It’s not even...close...
lines.zh: : 不……不对……我刚把那些事都告诉你了。那……那不叫完美……甚至根本……不沾边……

lines.en: : There’s a reason Sensei looks at you as much as he does...and it’s so...{i}so{/i} clear when I can see you up close like this...
lines.zh: : Sensei 会那么频繁地看你，是有原因的……而且像这样近距离看着你的时候，那原因……{i}那么{/i}清楚……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn28
: Ami...what’s going on?...
lines.zh: : Ami……怎么了？……

lines.en: : What are you doing?...
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？……

lines.en: : What do you {i}want{/i} me to do?...
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让我干什么？……

lines.en: : You feel it too, don’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你也感觉到了，对吧？……

lines.en: : I feel...a lot of things right now...but we haven’t really finished our conversation about...
lines.zh: : 我现在感觉……到很多东西……可我们还没真正聊完关于……

lines.en: : Are you sure?...I think we did...
lines.zh: : 是吗？……我觉得聊完了……

lines.en: : No...I need to know what you’ll do if...
lines.zh: : 不……我需要知道你会怎么做，如果……

lines.en: : If what?...
lines.zh: : 如果什么？……

lines.en: : If...Sensei does something...when I confront him about this...
lines.zh: : 如果……Sensei 做了什么……在我为这件事质问他的时候……

lines.en: : You’re gonna confront him?...
lines.zh: : 你要去质问他？……

lines.en: : I can’t just...ignore this...I need to know...how he got them...
lines.zh: : 我不能就这么……无视这件事……我需要知道……他是怎么弄到那些照片的……

lines.en: : Will you let him touch you if he asks?...
lines.zh: : 如果他提出来，你会让他碰你吗？……

lines.en: : Will...
: Will you hate me if I do?...
lines.zh: : 如果我答应了，你会恨我吗？……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn29
: Will you let {i}me{/i} touch you if I ask?...
lines.zh: : 如果我提出来，你会让{i}我{/i}碰你吗？……

lines.en: : {i}You?...{/i}But...Wait a second...Hold on! Aren’t you straight?! Are you just messing with me right now?! You are, aren’t you?!
lines.zh: : 我？……可……等等。等等！{i}你{/i}不是喜欢男生的吗？！你现在是在耍我吧？！你是在耍我，对吧？！

lines.en: : Are you nervous?...
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗？……

lines.en: : Isn’t that obvious?! This isn’t how this conversation is supposed to go!
lines.zh: : 这还不明显吗？！这话题不该这么发展的！

lines.en: : I’m sorry...you’re just...
lines.zh: : 对不起……你只是……

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn30
: So cute up close...
lines.zh: : 近距离看太可爱了……

lines.en: : Wha...
: Uta...
lines.zh: : Uta……

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Let’s be needy {i}together...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们{i}一起{/i}做个黏人的女孩吧……

lines.en: else:
: Let’s do for each other what {i}he{/i} won’t do for us...
lines.zh: : 让我们为彼此做那些{i}他{/i}不肯为我们做的事……

lines.en: scene black
: {i}I’ve gotta get back to work!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我得回去工作了！{/i}

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn31
scene amimaidreturn32
: Well...that might make things a little awkward.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那可能会让气氛有点尴尬。

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn33
: Oh, hey. How did your talk with Ami go?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。你跟 Ami 谈得怎么样？

lines.en: : We almost kissed.
lines.zh: : 我们差点就亲上了。

lines.en: : Cool. We’ve got a party of seven coming in at-
lines.zh: : 酷。我们七点有一桌七位的客人——

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn34
: YOU WHAT?!
lines.zh: : 你什么？！

lines.en: : Uta-chan’s powers...work against her again...
lines.zh: : Uta 酱的能力……又一次反噬了她自己……

lines.en: : You almost {i}kissed?!{/i} How?!
lines.zh: : 你差点{i}亲上{/i}了？！怎么搞的？！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn35
: With our mouths, obviously!
lines.zh: : 用嘴，显然！

lines.en: : I know that, idiot! But what could have possibly happened in the five minutes you were in there that led to that?! Weren’t you just teaching her about parfaits?!
lines.zh: : 我知道，白痴！可在里面那五分钟里到底发生了什么，才会演变成那样？！你不是只在教她芭菲的事吗？！

lines.en: : I was teaching her about the long-term effects of trauma and how some nuts are easier to crack than others!
lines.zh: : 我是在教她创伤的长期影响，以及有些坚果比其他坚果更好撬开！

lines.en: : We’re selling nuts now?!
lines.zh: : 我们现在开始卖坚果了吗？！

lines.en: scene amimaidreturn36
: Can you two stop yelling?! We have customers in here!
lines.zh: : 你们两个别喊了行吗？！店里还有客人呢！

lines.en: scene black
: Uta almost broke the biggest rule of the cafe! And Ami definitely shouldn’t be allowed to work here anymore!
lines.zh: : Uta 差点破了咖啡厅最大的规矩！而且绝对不该再让 Ami 在这儿工作了！

lines.en: : Hi! Uhh...
: Bye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Oh my God. Did she look at me? I was looking away. Chika-chan! Did Ami look at-
lines.zh: : 我的天。她看我了吗？我当时在看别处。Chika 酱！Ami 有没有看——

lines.en: : Get with the program, Uta-chan! We’ve got nuts to sell!
lines.zh: : 进入状态啊，Uta 酱！我们还有坚果要卖呢！

lines.en: : Aaaaah!!!!! What just happened?!?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！！！！刚才到底发生了什么？！！？！

lines.en: $ utaspring1 = True
{i}Uta’s affection with Ami has...increased?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 与 Ami 的好感度……提升了？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...wherever Sensei is...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……在 Sensei 所在的某个地方……{/i}
